counting_rules.people_or_runs: Count distinct funnel_run_id within review_batch, route_path, device_type, traffic_source and UTM dimensions.
counting_rules.events: Count distinct event_id after filtering funnel_eligible=true.
counting_rules.default_prefill: calculator_default_view is diagnostic only and must never count as tool_result.
counting_rules.explicit_confirmation: calculate_click is diagnostic only because live user-origin results can precede explicit confirmation; it carries funnel_run_id but funnel_eligible=false.
counting_rules.copy_and_share: copy_result and share_result represent completed actions; *_click events are intent diagnostics only.
counting_rules.aliases: Legacy names are normalized before dispatch, so one interaction emits one canonical event instead of canonical plus alias copies.

notes: 20260723 aligns the contract with live calculation: tool_start → user-origin tool_result → result_next_action_click. Prefill remains excluded, calculate_click is diagnostic, and run/event IDs support deduplication.
